content:
If you like the new wallpapers Apple has designed for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to get them—you can download them right here, right now.

Download the all-new iPhone 18 Pro wallpapers

While the default iOS wallpapers animate dynamically and react to the device's motion and gestures, what follows are static images taken directly from the first iOS 27 candidate build.

The candidate build doesn't appear to include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so you may have to wait a few more weeks, possibly until iOS 27.1.

Remember to tap on an image to download the full-resolution wallpaper, then set it as your background via the Photos app or the Settings app (if you're on an iOS device).

For comprehensive coverage of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event from 9to5Mac, click here.
